Practised drawing square and triangular numbers with dot pictures.
Used equal rows and columns to identify square numbers and counted triangular totals.
Used a new-row and side-column picture to find the difference between consecutive squares.
Initially counted 20 instead of 19 for 9×9 to 10×10, then corrected it by counting the corner once.
Needs more practice explaining why a picture proves a pattern.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised visualising square and triangular numbers with dot pictures. They used rows, columns, and the “corner counted once” method; the 20-versus-19 mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask them to draw 4×4 and 5×5 squares and explain the added row, added column, and shared corner.
